bio.Bios: Hey, my name is Hayley Su, and I initiated in the spring quarter of my first year with the Alpha Phi class. In my free time, I enjoy photography, hiking, painting, and trying new matcha spots. Feel free to ask me about the places I’ve traveled to or my experience studying abroad. Can’t wait to meet everyone!
